ContentDecomposedPage.description: Layout metadata with element skeletons, deduplicated property data, and element-to-data mappings. A client that caches this response as the skeleton and later fetches only a data response for the same layout compares the layout `id` and `version` of the two responses, and refetches this skeleton on a mismatch.

skeletons.description: The structure of the page with no property values; every value is served once through `data` and located through `assignments`.

data.description: Every value the page serves, held once: a response-local reference id mapped to the value it holds. A value may be any JSON type, including an encoded entity payload. The reference ids are minted while walking this one response and carry no meaning outside it — nothing may store one or assume a particular literal. An empty map is serialized as `[]` rather than `{}` (consistent with Shopware's JSON-map fields).

oneOf.description: The empty data map, serialized as `[]`.

assignments.description: Which element property points at which value: element id mapped to property key mapped to the reference id naming that value in `data`. Every reference id here resolves in `data`; a dangling one is an internal fault, not a state a client has to handle. An empty map is serialized as `[]` rather than `{}` (consistent with Shopware's JSON-map fields).

oneOf.description: The empty assignments map, serialized as `[]`.
